name: Queens Crossing
summary: Queens Crossing is a multilevel shopping center in Flushing, Queens, specializing in Asian specialty retail stores, restaurants, and a diverse food court. This popular destination serves as a cultural and commercial hub for the area's vibrant Asian-American community, offering authentic shopping and dining experiences.
demographics: Queens Crossing primarily serves the diverse Asian-American community of Flushing and surrounding Queens neighborhoods, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals. The trade area encompasses one of the largest and most affluent Asian populations in New York City, with visitors typically ranging from 25-55 years old who seek authentic Asian specialty goods, dining, and services. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for cultural authenticity, with customers traveling from across the tri-state area for the center's unique Asian retail and restaurant offerings. The center draws multigenerational family groups, particularly on weekends, who combine shopping with dining experiences.
description: Queens Crossing stands as a premier multilevel shopping destination in the heart of Flushing, Queens, serving as a cultural and commercial hub for one of New York City's most vibrant Asian-American communities. This modern shopping center has established itself as a go-to destination for authentic Asian specialty stores, offering an extensive roster of retail shops that cater to diverse tastes and needs. The center features a comprehensive food court alongside standalone restaurants, providing visitors with an impressive array of authentic Asian dining options that draw food enthusiasts from across the metropolitan area. With convenient operating hours from 11 AM to 11 PM daily, Queens Crossing accommodates both daytime shoppers and evening diners, making it a versatile destination for the community. The center's strategic location at 136-17 39th Avenue, combined with its Laz Parking facilities, ensures accessibility for the thousands of visitors who have rated it highly with over 2,000 reviews, reflecting its importance as a cornerstone of Queens' retail landscape.
